sections.text:
[Effects]
Reduces physical and magic damage taken by XL.
Reduces physical damage taken by S+.
Reduces magic damage taken by S+.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Star elemental Helm/Hat/Armor/Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
